reviews.text: Ella is lovely and she does a great job.

First time grooming for our 1 year old Patterdale Terrier so wasn’t sure how well he’d behave but Ella was great with him and made sure he had a positive experience which I’m very grateful for. Would definitely recommend
I’m so pleased we found Ella! She’s amazing with our nervous dog 🐶 he always looks so gorgeous after his groom and we would recommend her to anyone! ❤️ …

So pleased I found Ella, I have an anxious dog who needs 1 on 1 time ideally with no other dogs around, this is exactly what Ella can provide for her. She took her time with my dog and was so kind and patient. I don’t think grooms will be anywhere near as stressful for her now we have found Ella, so thank you!
Ella is an amazing dog groomer! Has the patience of a saint with my big dog, super friendly, and truly cares! Would recommend to her anyone!
Thanks for making Ted look fabulous he is so energetic and you have the best patience. Your service is highly recommended 5 stars
Lovely relaxed environment for my crazy spaniel. He came out gleaming! Thank you

Elle was just such a lovely person! She took care to bond with my red fox lab and really understood her very well. My dog looked gorgeous after her groom and her nails were cut with care.
I shall definitely be back and my dog just loved the attention and genuine friendliness.

My anxious cavapoo had her first cut at One Ell of a Groom this week and she was so well cared for and has a really lovely cut. I will definitely return and have already booked again for six weeks time. Thank you

First groom for Bella today. Ella was lovely.   Bella loved her .  Ella was really at ease and helpful with suggestions for nail clipping.   Bella is now sulking which she always does when left anyway.
Will be definitely going again
Ell was lovley ! Did a really good job and was very well priced !

Ella was amazing with my Shih Tzu puppy. This was Lottie’s first puppy groom and Ella did an amazing job, especially with how wriggly she is! Lottie was really happy when I picked her up which reassured me she had been looked after well. One sleepy puppy now. Thank you!

Ell is wonderful with our Cocker Spaniel. Delighted with the groom, and how she has a plan in mind - leaving areas to grow & cutting others, in preparation for better styling in the future (having to reverse a few home cuts).

Ella at One Ell of a Groom is so reassuring, knows dogs so well and just loves what she does! Our dog, a Labrador retriever, loved his groom with Ella, he came away so soft and fluffy, but also so calm, yet excitable too. We completely trusted Reggie with you and would definitely recommend. Thank you, Whitney and Charlie x

We have had our boy groomed twice by Ella now and we can’t sing her praises enough. He comes out looking amazing, smelling amazing and also he’s just so happy.
Ella is accommodating around our work schedule and you can really tell she loves her job. We feel very lucky to have found Ella to pamper our boy. Rusty is looking forward to his next groom
Ella is such a lovely girl and dealt with my teenage lab beautifully even though he’s a handful and full of attitude😂! he really enjoyed his bath and groom and we will be back soon! …

Great response to enquiry, friendly nature on arrival. Showed patience and care towards our pup. Did a great job and our pup was relaxed. Especially happy with the 1-1 service and rarely priced.
Would highly recommend this service.

What can I say-both my furry babies visited Ella today-cannot express how impressed I am!!-very attentive, patient and wonderful she was with both. Went in for a bath, and de-shedding-removed pretty much another dog!!
Would highly recommend and will definitely be using her again!!…
Thank you Ella.🫶🏻
I highly recommend one ell of a groom as she did a fantastic job of grooming my cavapoo buddy as he really needed a full groom .

Ella is literally a miracle worker! Previously, our cockapoo has been a nightmare, we’ve had to pick him up from other groomers because he would be too nervous and scared, but when I saw that Ella was back and dog grooming, I knew I had to book him in! Her patience and positivity took our pup from being a big hairy, matted mess to looking like the most perfectly groomed dog! I was amazed that El had been able to do a full groom on our cockapoo, he has previously hated having his hair cut and has been terrified of the hair dryer, but El has completely transformed him! We will most definitely be continuing to use One Ell of a Groom and I can confidently say that our pup has received One Ell of a Groom! Thank you so much, El!

Ella is a fantastic groomer! Absolutely amazing communication and attention to detail. She took the time to let our nervous and noisy little girl settle in as she assessed her coat and asked us how we'd like her groomed. Our little girl looks beautiful. Highly recommend.
My chocolate Labrador went to One Ell of a Groom and came back smelling so good and he didn’t want to leave the salon as he enjoyed his time there compared to when I try to groom him!
Ella takes extreme care and we always get the groom we want, wouldn't trust anyone else with our pups fur. Thanks Ella!
Highly recommend One Ell of a Groom. Ella is always so professional and does a brilliant job. Definitely worth booking!
Ella is wonderful. So good with our anxious pup. She always gets the length and all the details right. Very communicative and easy to schedule with. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Ella.

Ella did a fab job with our newly adopted 4 year old cocker spaniel. She looks likes herself but better! Ella has a lovely clean professional set up with a warm friendly and knowledgeable approach. Thank you we'll be back

A big thank you Ella for being so lovely in your service and helpful with your tips & feedback on our 3 month old Cockapoo puppy, Reign - who was so well behaved in his first ever puppy groom session with you! We look forward to seeing you again in a few weeks!

Appreciate the amazing pics you took of him and sent over!🥰
Been a couple of time now with my cockapoo ill not take him anywhere else, you get that personal touch aswell brilliant service.
Took Lyra for a groom today and she's come out looking wonderful,  as always. She is always well cared for and excited to be clipped.
Fantastic groom today from Ella! She looks after our Labradoodle so well and really listens to how we would like her groomed. Highly recommend!

It was our puppy first time to be groomed and
Couldn’t believe  how stunning she looked very impressed many thanks Ella
A great experience fur beau he’s was very cared for and looked amazing showing his new cut beau will be back!
She does a super groom and is very caring
Highly recommend - have a cavalier that hates being groomed but even after the second visit was happy to see Ella. Really good service and groom was excellent.

My miniature poodle was groomed by Ell for the first time today, he looks so lovely 😍.. Her attention to detail and care for my little pooch was clear to see.
He had lots of compliments walking to the car through Beeston High St 😉.
Would highly recommend. …

I took my border collie to Ella and from start to finish she was amazing, I was nervous at first as never took her to a groomers before but definitely made the right choice with Ella. Will defo be retuning, thank you.
My two labs love going to Ella for their grooms. Always come back very happy and smelling lovely. Ella is extremely friendly and amazing with the dogs!

My dog Lucy is very wary of showers at home so we thought she’s struggle being groomed but she was perfect with Ella!

Ella was excellent with dealing with her 😊 a very happy dog/owner at the end of it. Thank you Ella!

My boy absolutely adores Ella! She is a fabulous lady that takes time and care with the dogs that she is grooming. Jake is quite a nervous dog, but she makes him feel so relaxed and at ease during his time with Ella!

Couldn’t recommend her enough for your pooches pamper sessions!

Took our very nervous puppy for his first groom along with his big brother and Ella was excellent! They looked amazing! Never felt so comfortable leaving my babies with someone than I did Ella (even family aha) will definitely be back. Thankyou Ella

Ella has been grooming my 3 year old sproodle since his very first puppy groom. She is very professional and pays attention to the detail. Henry is always so excited to see Ella and looks amazing afterwards.
